episodes.title: Queen Bee
episodes.summary: New to town Inspector Fitz joins forces with local detective Arch to solve the murder of a back-to-nature group leader.

episodes.title: Kill Lil
episodes.summary: Fitz and Arch engage in a game of cat and mouse as they race to determine the target of an assassin on Bastille Day.

episodes.title: Off with His Head
episodes.summary: When a billionaire is found decapitated, Fitz and Arch dig into the victim's family.

episodes.title: Island Getaway
episodes.summary: Fitz and Arch work with a Newfoundland Officer from Fitz's past to apprehend an infamous bank robber who's escaped to Saint-Pierre.

episodes.title: The Bogman Cometh
episodes.summary: When an archaeologist winds up dead in her dig site, Arch and Fitz look into a group of academics to find the murderer.

episodes.title: Only the Good Die Young
episodes.summary: Arch's investigation into Gallagher takes a turn when his son becomes the prime suspect after a dead body washes up at a music festival.

episodes.title: Ghost From The Past
episodes.summary: Arch and Fitz race against time to save a kidnapped flight attendant, and then one of their own.

episodes.title: With a Little Help From My Friends
episodes.summary: When the severed finger of a handyman mysteriously turns up, Fitz and Arch's investigation turns into a case of vigilante justice.

episodes.title: Bad Friends, Bons Ennemis
episodes.summary: Arch and Fitz investigate Fitz's enemy, Premier O'Brien when he becomes the prime suspect in a bachelor party gone wrong.

episodes.title: Reap What We Sow
episodes.summary: Amidst several personal revelations, Arch's investigation into Gallagher comes to a head when a murdered body washes up the shore.

episodes.title: Sleep No More
episodes.summary: When a man is found brutally murdered, Arch and Fitz suspect it is the work of "The Abstract Killer", a serial killer who plagued Saint-Pierre long ago and was believed to be dead.

episodes.title: Inside Woman
episodes.summary: A hit and run victim causes Fitz to confront his undercover past, and when his ex-partner unexpectedly appears, she joins him and Arch in a race against time to stop a money heist.

episodes.title: The Mouth of Hell
episodes.summary: When a diver mysteriously drowns, Arch and Fitz are drawn into a world of shipwrecks and plundering, leading them to wonder if the infamous waterway Mouth of Hell has claimed yet another victim.

episodes.title: Death at a Funeral
episodes.summary: A world-famous violinist and convicted predator dies while performing at his father's funeral, propelling Fitz and Arch into a search for his killer among mourners and those protesting his presence.

episodes.title: Dirty Jane
episodes.summary: Our coroner Natasha is at the heart of the inquiry into her brother's recent murder. Arch and Fitz question how the man, who was reported dead over a year ago, re-appeared and who is his killer?

episodes.title: Wheelman
episodes.summary: A corpse in Fitz's motel room leads him and Arch to a sophisticated international car theft ring with ties to Fitz's landlady Marguerite, and forces them to work with SPMP's latest asset: Gallagher.

episodes.title: Vanishing Act
episodes.summary: When a Newfoundland teenager with a rare blood disorder disappears during a field trip to Saint-Pierre, Arch and Fitz race to determine if it's a parental abduction or something far more nefarious.

episodes.title: High School Confidential
episodes.summary: When a man dies on the eve of his high school reunion, Fitz and Arch seek help from one of his graduating classmates, Renuf. The trio investigate his friends and discover a tragedy buried in the past.

episodes.title: Red rum, Red rum
episodes.summary: We are transported to a speakeasy in full-swing at Veda's bar until a dead body is discovered. Arch and Fitz's murder investigation takes them down a Prohibition path of bootlegging and smuggling.

episodes.title: Tick, Tick, Boom!
episodes.summary: Patty and Prefect Diard are trapped on a bomb-rigged plane as Fitz and Arch race against a ticking clock trying to discover who set the device, and how they can disarm it before it's too late.

episodes.title: Cerulean Blue
episodes.summary: It seems The Abstract Killer is back! Arch and Fitz rely on psychologist Dr. Fouchard's serial killer expertise as they investigate another gruesome murder and rush to save one of their own.

episodes.title: Who the F is Alice?
episodes.summary: Two murders are part of a larger conspiracy of betrayal, gunrunning and shifting alliances. As Gallagher's empire is fracturing, Arch and Fitz must face down a deeper threat stalking Saint-Pierre.
